title: Psychology Facts
hook: Quiz: can a random number change your guess?
facts: In 1974, Tversky and *Kahneman* spun a rigged wheel of fortune.
It landed on *10* for some people, and *65* for others.
Then they asked: what percent of UN members are *African* countries?
Wheel said 10, median guess *25%*. Wheel said 65, guess *45%*.
outro: A random number anchored them. Did you guess?
